summary: SDK 57 upgrade — ROUND 2 regression / bug-fix verification (frontend only). VERIFIED: the 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' console error is GONE on HomeScreen mount and after 2 hard reloads (0 text-node errors captured, 0 red LogBox toast visible). The `motivation !== ''` and `!!profile?.profile_image` guards work correctly AND do not hide content: the motivation card still renders on Home with the expected text ('The best project you'll ever work on is you.'). Route-crash sweep of all 10 requested routes (/subscription, /body-analyzer, /meal-questionnaire, /workout-questionnaire, /food-log, /saved-meals, /macro-targets, /settings, /grocery-list, /admin) — every route mounted without any text-node errors and without any non-benign console errors. Bottom tab bar: all 5 tabs (Home, Workouts, Nutrition, Ask AI, Profile) switch correctly, Ionicons render, 0 errors on each. Login works with sdk57tester@example.com / Test1234! and lands at /. Benign warnings observed (ignored per request): shadow* deprecated, expo-notifications web push token, and one dev-only 'GO_BACK not handled by any navigator' when directly deep-linking /food-log which correctly redirects free-tier users via router.back(). Two flows could NOT be exercised end-to-end due to test-account limitations (not regressions): (a) workout-detail — the sdk57tester account has 'No Workouts Yet' so no card exists to open, (b) food-log description input — the account is free-tier and food-log correctly gates via requirePremium() + router.back(), so no input is rendered. Deprecated packages detected: none.
action_items: OPTIONAL: If future tests need to cover workout-detail and the food-log description input end-to-end, either seed a workout for sdk57tester (POST /api/workouts/generate) or flip the account's subscription_status to 'active' (or use a different premium test user). Not a regression — just a coverage gap.
critical_code_review_comments: Round-1 bug fix is correct: `{motivation !== '' && ...}` and `{!!profile?.profile_image && ...}` in app/(tabs)/index.tsx (lines 350 and 363) properly guard against React 19.2.3's stricter text-node parenting under RN Web 0.21.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx is still 796 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting HomeScreen (quick actions, profile picture modal viewer, workout stats tile) into subcomponents in a follow-up.
Fun-of-audit: no other screen surfaced a similar strict-text warning under React 19.2.3 during this sweep.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested scope — text-node bug is GONE, all 10 routes crash-free, all 5 tabs work, motivation content still shows
